# Vedic Kundali: Birth Chart Generator

> A free online Vedic birth chart (Janam Kundli) generator. Enter birth date, time, and place to get a North Indian style kundli with Lagna, planetary positions, nakshatras, and Vimshottari dasha periods.

Live: https://kundli.vayuputra.co/

## Features

- North Indian style birth chart (Rashi chart)
- Ascendant (Lagna), planets in signs and houses, and nakshatras
- Vimshottari dasha periods
- Lahiri ayanamsa (sidereal zodiac)
- Download the chart as a PDF or image

## Useful for

- Making a Janam Kundli from birth details
- Checking Lagna, Moon sign, and nakshatra
- Looking up current and upcoming dasha periods

## About

- Free, no sign-up, nothing to install; runs entirely in your browser.
- Made by [Suraj Malpani](https://surajmalpani.github.io/), published by [Vayuputra](https://vayuputra.co/), which lists all its free tools.
